dct_description_sm: The goal of research was to to create a GIS of the landforms and quantify the amount of erosion between each year from 2004 until 2012. The main study sites are thaw slumps A, B, and C situated along the south coast of the island. The aims of this research include: (1) creating a 3-dimensional model of three retrogressive thaw slumps showing the erosion between 2004 and 2012; (2) creating several 3-dimensional models of past surfaces in order to estimate erosion volumes and (3) using the resulting volumetric soil loss values to estimate SOC flux into the Arctic Ocean.
dct_title_s: 3D modelling of retrogressive thaw slump erosion, Thetis Bay, Herschel Island, YT, Canada
